secrets.name: SESSION_SECRET
secrets.description: Secret signing key for dashboard login sessions. Generated for development; use a strong dedicated value for production.

secrets.name: WEBHOOK_API_KEY
secrets.description: Optional shared API key for backward-compat X-API-Key auth. Primary bot auth is Bearer BOT_SECRET (stored in DB, regeneratable via Settings).

secrets.name: BOT_SECRET
secrets.description: Optional env override for the bot authentication secret. If unset, one is auto-generated and stored in the database (viewable/regeneratable in Settings > Security).

secrets.name: GOOGLE_SPREADSHEET_ID
secrets.description: Google Sheets spreadsheet ID for automated daily performance reporting. Optional — only needed to enable the Google Sheets export feature.

secrets.name: GOOGLE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_EMAIL
secrets.description: Google service account email (e.g. bot@project.iam.gserviceaccount.com) authorized to edit the spreadsheet. Optional — only needed for Google Sheets export.

secrets.name: GOOGLE_PRIVATE_KEY
secrets.description: Private key for the Google service account (with \n for newlines). Optional — only needed for Google Sheets export.
